law_record.title: Crossing sidewalks—Entering roadways
law_record.text: The driver of a vehicle within a business or residence district emerging or entering an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision, and upon entering the roadway shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles approaching on said roadway.

activation_conditions: the subject emerges from or enters an alley, driveway or building
the location is a business or residence district
the vehicle is about to cross a sidewalk or sidewalk area
residue: 'business or residence district' is a legal region class — a reading assumption
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: stop immediately before the sidewalk, then yield to pedestrians, then on entering the roadway yield to all approaching vehicles — three ordered duties
a full halt, judged by the drv.stopped parameters
the trace must cover the whole emergence for the three stages to be separable
